name: Emergency Patch: Prompt contract hardening (no-plan + strict signals)

context.problem_statement: FADE sessions are pausing due to missing recognized completion signals and Claude Code entering a 'planning phase' (writing a plan file and exiting) instead of implementing changes. This causes 'Session Interrupted' even when work is ready to proceed.
context.why_this_matters: YOLO mode must remain autonomous and resilient. The prompt contract is the primary mechanism to keep Claude Code in 'implement-now' mode and to ensure FADE receives strict completion tokens it can parse.
context.scope_note: This patch ONLY updates prompt.md. No code changes outside prompt.md are allowed in this patch.

user_stories.title: Prevent plan-only exits in autonomous runs
user_stories.description: As the operator, I want Claude Code to implement immediately (not produce a plan document and stop), so YOLO runs do not pause without making code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Update prompt.md to explicitly forbid plan-only outputs, planning-phase handoffs, or writing plan documents as the final output in autonomous runs.
Update prompt.md to explicitly instruct: if the model has already created a plan file, it must implement the plan immediately and MUST NOT create a new plan.
Update prompt.md to explicitly instruct: do not ask the user for confirmation; proceed with implementation unless the work is truly impossible, in which case emit BLOCKED: <reason>.

Update prompt.md to explicitly instruct that the model must always end each iteration with exactly one of the recognized signals on its own line: STORY_DONE: <US-ID> OR ALL_COMPLETE OR BLOCKED: <reason>.
Update prompt.md to explicitly instruct that STORY_DONE must be printed as an exact line beginning with 'STORY_DONE:' and include the current user story id.
Ensure wording is unambiguous and placed near the top of prompt.md so it is always in context.
implementation_notes: This patch is prompt-only. Do not refactor code or change orchestrator parsing here.
Add a small section titled 'Autonomous Execution Contract' near the very top of prompt.md.

user_stories.title: Standardize completion tokens and forbid variants
user_stories.description: As the operator, I want the LLM to output completion tokens in the exact format FADE expects so runs don't falsely pause.
acceptance_criteria: Update prompt.md to forbid token variants such as 'ALL_COMPLETE: ...' or 'ALL_COMPLETE - ...' as the final completion line.
Update prompt.md to instruct that the final completion line must be EXACTLY 'ALL_COMPLETE' with no suffix when the PRD is fully complete.
Update prompt.md to instruct that 'STORY_DONE: US-xxx' must be a standalone line and should be the last non-empty line of the message when a user story is completed.
Update prompt.md to instruct that no additional commentary may appear AFTER the completion token line.
Update prompt.md to instruct that if uncertain whether work is complete, the model should not guess completion; it should either implement missing work or emit 'BLOCKED: <reason>'.
implementation_notes: This is a prompt contract reinforcement. Keep it short and prominent.
Make explicit that FADE is a strict parser and token formatting is critical.

out_of_scope: Changing FADE code to parse additional completion token variants
definition_of_done: prompt.md updated with an 'Autonomous Execution Contract' section meeting the acceptance criteria
Progress logged as per FADE protocol
